payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Attention-Sum Reader model shows significant improvements when trained on the BookTest dataset compared to the original CBT test data.

claims.text: Training on the BookTest dataset improves the accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model on the original CBT test data by a much larger margin than many recent attempts to improve the model architecture.
The ensemble model trained on the BookTest dataset even exceeds the human baseline provided by Facebook.
